title: Resultados y estadística: explicar resultados
product: Explicación oral de resultados cuantitativos con una limitación, transferida a un caso nuevo

objectives.text: Describir dos resultados cuantitativos con cifras, unidades y comparación correctas.
Distinguir asociación de causalidad al leer y al hablar.
Usar lenguaje prudente (suggest, may, was associated with) en lugar de afirmaciones causales.
Responder una pregunta sobre limitaciones del diseño.

language_level.spanish_support: medio: instrucciones en español, materiales en inglés

lexis.example: The revised procedure was associated with higher output.
Output was higher on Line B compared with Line A.
lexis.confusions: 'compared to' también se usa; ambas son aceptables.
El orden de los valores sigue el orden en que se nombraron los grupos.

lexis.example: The defect rate was 0.5 percentage points lower.
lexis.confusions: 0,5 puntos porcentuales no es lo mismo que 0,5 %: de 4,0 % a 3,5 % es una reducción relativa de 12,5 %.

lexis.example: The findings suggest that the revised procedure may improve output.
lexis.confusions: 'suggest' no es 'sugerir hacer algo' aquí: indica inferencia prudente.

lexis.example: The revised procedure may improve output.
lexis.confusions: 'may' expresa posibilidad, no permiso, en este contexto.

lexis.example: These results do not establish causality.
lexis.confusions: 'casualty' (víctima) es otra palabra: cuidado con el orden de las letras.

lexis.example: The lines were not randomly assigned to the procedures.
lexis.confusions: Pasiva: el sujeto recibe la asignación.

lexis.example: Further research is needed to separate the two effects.
One limitation is that the teams had different levels of experience.
collocations: one limitation of this study is that …

lexis.example: Line A used the existing procedure, while Line B used a revised one.
lexis.confusions: También significa 'mientras' temporal; aquí contrasta dos grupos.

lexis.example: However, the lines were not randomly assigned.
lexis.confusions: Va seguido de coma al inicio de la oración.

grammar.example: The lines were not randomly assigned.

grammar.pattern: X was N% higher than Y; a difference of N percentage points
grammar.example: Output on Line B was 15% higher than on Line A.

pronunciation.focus: Números: one hundred and twenty / one hundred and thirty-eight; four point oh / three point five
pronunciation.note: En inglés estadounidense es frecuente 'one hundred twenty' sin 'and'; ambas son legítimas.

pronunciation.focus: Grupos de sentido y pausa antes de 'but they do not establish causality'
pronunciation.note: La cautela final lleva énfasis en NOT.

resources.title: Two production lines (texto principal)
resources.body: We compared two production lines over eight weeks. Line A used the existing scheduling procedure, while Line B used a revised procedure. Average daily output was 120 units on Line A and 138 units on Line B. Defect rates were 4.0% and 3.5%, respectively. However, the teams had different levels of experience, and the lines were not randomly assigned to the procedures. The findings suggest that the revised procedure may improve output, but they do not establish causality. Further research is needed to separate the effect of scheduling from the effect of team experience.

resources.title: Transfer case: response times of a web service
resources.body: We compared two versions of a web service over four weeks. Version 1 used the existing cache configuration, while Version 2 used a revised configuration. Median response time was 250 milliseconds for Version 1 and 200 milliseconds for Version 2. Error rates were 1.2% and 1.0%, respectively. However, Version 2 was deployed during a period of lower traffic, and the versions were not tested under the same load.

resources.title: Transfer case: two checkout pages
resources.body: An online store in Chile compared two checkout pages for six weeks. Page A was shown to customers in Santiago, while Page B was shown to customers in Concepción. The conversion rate was 2.5% on Page A and 3.0% on Page B. Average order value was 42,000 and 40,500 pesos, respectively. However, customers in the two cities have different profiles, and customers were not randomly assigned to the pages.

resources.title: Transfer case: two picking methods
resources.body: A distribution centre compared two picking methods for five weeks. Zone 1 used paper lists, while Zone 2 used handheld scanners. Picking accuracy was 96.0% in Zone 1 and 98.5% in Zone 2. Average orders per hour were 52 and 55, respectively. However, Zone 2 handled smaller orders, and the zones were not randomly assigned to the methods.

resources.title: Deferred check: maintenance plans in a plant in Ñuble
resources.body: A plant in Ñuble compared two maintenance plans over ten weeks. Machine group 1 kept the existing plan, while group 2 followed a new preventive plan. Unplanned stops were 12 per month in group 1 and 9 per month in group 2. Average repair times were 3.2 and 3.0 hours, respectively. However, group 2 had newer machines, and the plans were not randomly assigned to the groups.

lessons.title: Leer y localizar diseño, duración, resultados y limitación
lessons.intro: Lee el texto con un propósito: vas a tener que explicarlo después. Primero responde sin traducción.

activities.prompt: What kind of study is described?

options.text: A randomized experiment with two production lines.
options.feedback: El texto dice explícitamente que las líneas no fueron asignadas aleatoriamente.

options.text: A comparison of two production lines over eight weeks, without random assignment.
A survey of workers about two scheduling procedures.
options.feedback: No se menciona una encuesta: se comparan cifras de producción.

evidence.instruction: Marca la oración que respalda tu respuesta.

sentences.text: We compared two production lines over eight weeks.
Average daily output was 120 units on Line A and 138 units on Line B.
However, the teams had different levels of experience, and the lines were not randomly assigned to the procedures.

evidence.feedback: La oración sobre la producción da resultados, no el diseño. Busca la duración y la asignación.

activities.explanation: Es un estudio comparativo de ocho semanas sin asignación aleatoria.

activities.prompt: Localiza los datos clave. Usa el orden que indica 'respectively'.

fields.label: Tasa de defectos, Line A (%)
fields.hint: 'respectively' asigna el primer valor al primer grupo nombrado.

fields.label: Tasa de defectos, Line B (%)
fields.hint: 'respectively' asigna el segundo valor al segundo grupo nombrado.

activities.explanation: Ocho semanas; 120 y 138 unidades/día; 4,0 % y 3,5 % de defectos.

activities.prompt: Which limitation does the text mention? Justify your answer in English or Spanish.

options.text: The study was too short.
options.feedback: El texto no critica la duración.

options.text: The teams had different experience and the lines were not randomly assigned.
The defect rates were measured incorrectly.

activities.explanation: La limitación es doble: experiencia distinta de los equipos y ausencia de asignación aleatoria.

lessons.title: Calcular e interpretar: percent frente a percentage points
lessons.intro: Calcula y luego decide cómo decirlo. Los valores no son prueba causal.

activities.prompt: Calcula: (1) ¿cuánto mayor, en %, es la producción de Line B que la de Line A? (2) ¿Cuál es la diferencia en defectos, en puntos porcentuales?

fields.label: Producción de B respecto de A (% mayor)

activities.explanation: B produce 15 % más que A; la diferencia de defectos es 0,5 puntos porcentuales (una reducción relativa de 12,5 %).

activities.prompt: Which sentence describes the defect rates accurately?

options.text: The defect rate on Line B was 0.5 percent lower.
options.feedback: '0.5 percent' sugiere una variación relativa; la resta de dos porcentajes se expresa en percentage points.

options.text: The defect rate on Line B was 0.5 percentage points lower.
The defect rate on Line B was 12.5 percentage points lower.
options.feedback: 12,5 es la reducción relativa (en %), no la diferencia en puntos.

activities.explanation: De 4,0 % a 3,5 % hay 0,5 percentage points; en términos relativos es 12,5 percent.

activities.prompt: Which statement fits the evidence in the text?

options.text: The revised procedure caused a 15% increase in output.
options.feedback: 'caused' afirma causalidad, y el diseño no lo permite.

options.text: The revised procedure proves that scheduling matters.
options.feedback: 'proves' es demasiado fuerte para un estudio sin asignación aleatoria.

options.text: The revised procedure was associated with 15% higher output.

activities.explanation: 'was associated with' describe la relación observada sin afirmar causa.

activities.prompt: Completa con la palabra que falta (una por espacio).
activities.text: Line A used the existing procedure, [[1]] Line B used a revised procedure. Defect rates were 4.0% and 3.5%, [[2]]. [[3]], the lines were not randomly assigned. The findings [[4]] that the revised procedure may improve output.

1.hint: Conector de contraste entre dos grupos.

2.hint: Indica que los valores siguen el orden de los grupos.

3.hint: Conector que introduce una objeción; va con coma.

near.show: 'show' es más fuerte; el texto usa un verbo de inferencia prudente.

lessons.title: Escuchar cifras, contrastes y cautela
lessons.intro: Responde primero sin transcripción. Las voces de esta lección son sintetizadas por el navegador.

activities.prompt: Escucha y escribe las cifras.

activities.transcript: Average daily output was one hundred and twenty units on Line A and one hundred and thirty-eight units on Line B. Defect rates were four point oh percent and three point five percent, respectively.

activities.prompt: Discrimina números parecidos.

audio.text: The pilot lasted thirteen weeks. Output increased by fifteen percent.

activities.transcript: The pilot lasted thirteen weeks. Output increased by fifteen percent.

questions.label: Duración
questions.prompt: How long did the pilot last?

options.text: 13 weeks
30 weeks
options.feedback: thirTEEN lleva el acento al final; THIRty, al inicio.

questions.label: Aumento

options.feedback: FIFty lleva el acento al inicio; fifTEEN, al final.

activities.prompt: Dictado breve: escribe la oración completa.

audio.text: However, the lines were not randomly assigned to the procedures.

activities.answer: However, the lines were not randomly assigned to the procedures.

activities.prompt: Shadowing: escucha el modelo, imita el ritmo y la pausa antes de 'but', con énfasis en NOT. Luego, sin mirar el texto, explica en una oración qué significa.

model.text: The findings suggest that the revised procedure may improve output, but they do not establish causality.
chunks: The findings suggest | that the revised procedure | may improve output, ||
but they do NOT | establish causality.

self_check: Pronuncié la -s final de 'findings' y 'suggest' sin vocal añadida.

lessons.title: Recuperar y aplicar: reformular una afirmación exagerada
lessons.intro: Sin modelo a la vista. Los últimos cinco ítems son de comprobación: cuenta tu primer intento.

activities.prompt: Quieres decir que el procedimiento nuevo estuvo asociado a más producción, sin afirmar causa. Completa: «The revised procedure ______ higher output.»

near.caused: 'caused' afirma causalidad; el diseño no lo permite.
near.is associated with: Correcto en estructura, pero el estudio ya terminó: usa pasado (was).
near.associated with: Falta el verbo: was associated with.

activities.prompt: Reformula esta afirmación para que respete el diseño comparativo y sus límites: «The new procedure caused a 15% increase.» Escribe una o dos oraciones en inglés.

checks.feedback: Evita 'caused' o 'proves': el estudio no permite afirmar causa.
Usa lenguaje prudente: 'was associated with', 'may', 'suggest'.
Menciona el límite: sin asignación aleatoria o la experiencia distinta de los equipos.
Conserva la cifra (15 %) al reformular.

activities.prompt: A study compared two warehouses. Warehouse 1 introduced a new layout and had 8% fewer delays than Warehouse 2. The warehouses were in different regions. Which conclusion is appropriate?

options.text: The new layout reduced delays by 8%.
The new layout was associated with fewer delays, but regional differences may explain part of the gap.
Regional differences caused the delays.

activities.explanation: Sin asignación aleatoria y con regiones distintas, solo puede hablarse de asociación.

activities.prompt: Absenteeism fell from 6% to 4%. Which description is correct?

options.text: It fell by 2 percent.
It fell by 2 percentage points, a relative reduction of about 33%.
It fell by 33 percentage points.

activities.text: Team X used the old software, [[1]] Team Y used the new version. Average task times were 14 and 11 minutes, [[2]]. The results [[3]] that the new version may save time.

Quieres introducir una limitación al final de tu exposición. Completa: «______ that the teams had different levels of experience.» (tres palabras)

near.one limitation was: Válido en un informe pasado; aquí se pide presente: is.

lessons.title: Producir e interactuar: explicar y defender los límites
lessons.intro: Graba sin leer un guion completo. Puedes usar notas de tres o cuatro palabras.

activities.prompt: Explica en 60–90 segundos los resultados del estudio de las dos líneas: diseño, dos cifras con su comparación y una limitación.

checks.feedback: No aparecen las cifras de producción en la transcripción.
Incluye lenguaje prudente: 'was associated with' o 'the findings suggest'.
Evita 'caused' o 'proves'.
Menciona la limitación: experiencia o asignación no aleatoria.

activities.prompt: Pregunta del público: «Why can't you conclude that scheduling caused the difference?» Responde en 30–60 segundos. Si no entiendes, pide aclaración (Could you clarify…?).

model.text: Why can't you conclude that scheduling caused the difference?

follow_ups: Could the difference be explained by team experience alone?
What would you change in a follow-up study?

checks.feedback: La respuesta debe nombrar la razón: sin asignación aleatoria o experiencia distinta.
Propón cómo separar los efectos en un estudio futuro.

activities.prompt: Escribe en inglés un párrafo de 80–120 palabras con los resultados y una limitación. Atribuye la información al estudio (The study compared…).

checks.feedback: Incluye las dos cifras de producción.
Expresa la diferencia de defectos en percentage points.
Usa lenguaje prudente.
Evita afirmaciones causales.
